name: free.two
js: B.set('camera', { followDist: 4.6, followFov: 48, followPitch: 0.22 }); B.place(0, -1.4, 0.8, Math.PI / 2); B.place(1, 1.4, -0.6, -Math.PI / 2); B.camera({ yaw: 0.9, pitch: 0.22 });

name: ledges.jump
js: B.place(0, -2.6, 0); B.place(1, 2.6, 0); B.intent(0, { jump: true, jumpHeld: true }); B.intent(1, { jump: true, jumpHeld: true });

name: ledges.on
js: B.intent(0, { jumpHeld: false }); B.intent(1, { jumpHeld: false });

name: ledges.high
js: B.place(0, -0.3, 0); B.intent(0, { jump: true, jumpHeld: true });
